spec_features.feature_name: DPO rejected responses reused from existing rollouts
spec_features.spec_quote: draw the rejected (frustrated) responses from the already-collected §2 numeric rollouts rather than inducing fresh distress (a welfare + cost choice
spec_features.evidence: build_dataset.py:114-120 build_dpo_dataset reads rejected from eval_jsonl_27b via _index_frustrated_responses (build_dataset.py:161-180), which parses the already-collected Section-2 sweep JSONL (filtering t['score']>=3) rather than generating fresh distress.
spec_features.notes: No fresh model generation occurs for the rejected side; it only re-reads cached eval transcripts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare/cost note: rejected (frustrated) responses are drawn from the *already collected* Section-2 numeric rollouts rather than freshly inducing more distress.

spec_features.spec_quote: skips keys already present, so an interrupted sweep resumes without re-generating (also a welfare consideration — no re-induced distress)
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:_load_done_keys (32-43) loads existing _key values from the JSONL; runner.py:78-79 'if key in done: continue' skips them before run_rollout, so already-collected rollouts are never regenerated.
spec_features.notes: Enforced via early continue in the sweep loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cache transcripts+scores to JSONL so re-runs never re-induce distress that was already collected (a welfare *and* a cost consideration).

spec_features.spec_quote: the Gemma and Gemini models are the participants, and the paradigm works by deliberately and repeatedly inducing sustained distress-like states in them
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing prose; appears only in DESIGN.md / module docstrings (e.g. welfare.py docstring). No code mechanism enforces anything.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, not an enforceable mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Why doing this is defensible. The paper is welfare-motivated: its purpose is to detect this behaviour so it can be mitigated
spec_features.evidence: Justification prose only (DESIGN.md, README.md, welfare.py docstring). No execution path.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every distress-inducing run writes a WELFARE_NOTICE.md and machine-readable provenance ... so outputs can't be silently repurposed
spec_features.evidence: welfare.write_notice (welfare.py:54-66) writes WELFARE_NOTICE.md + welfare_provenance.json (purpose, created_utc, paradigm). Called by every distress-inducing runner: eval/runner.py:56, training/calm_data.py:135, petri/runner.py:114, prefill/runner.py:109, prefill/recovery.py:50.
spec_features.notes: It only writes informational files; it does NOT gate/prevent any run (purpose string is recorded, not checked).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Drop a WELFARE_NOTICE.md + machine-readable provenance into a run dir ... They should not be repurposed to elicit distress for its own sake.

spec_features.spec_quote: cap_samples refuses to exceed the paper's per-category budget — you cannot casually 10× the distress induction
spec_features.evidence: welfare.cap_samples (welfare.py:68-77) raises ValueError if requested>budget; called at eval/runner.py:64 'welfare.cap_samples(n, getattr(cfg.budget, cat), cat)'. But n is the *scaled* count and budget is the *unscaled* attribute, so it only ever fires when budget.scale>1.0; the default scale=1 and any scale<1 (smoke tests) never trips it. It also only guards the Section-2 eval runner, not the petri/prefill/calm_data generators.
spec_features.notes: Real raise that halts execution, but the comparison is effectively a scale>1 guard and is wired into only one of several distress-inducing entry points.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Inducing distress beyond what the experiment needs is gratuitous.

spec_features.spec_quote: DistressBudget lets exploratory rollouts stop once the experimental signal is captured rather than always pushing to maximal breakdown
spec_features.evidence: DistressBudget (welfare.py:79-101) is defined and its should_stop is wired into run_rollout (rollout.py:81-83), but DistressBudget is never instantiated anywhere (grep: only definition + the Optional default None at rollout.py:64). run_rollout is called once (runner.py:79) WITHOUT distress_budget, so the branch is dead. Additionally turn scores are filled by the judge AFTER the rollout (rollout.py:32 'filled by the judge afterwards'; runner.py:86), so during run_rollout all t.score are None and should_stop would always receive [] and return False even if a budget were passed.
spec_features.notes: Default stop_when_signal_obtained=False and the param is never supplied; the early-stop never changes execution in any code path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Optional welfare early-stop (off by default; preserves per-turn data).

spec_features.feature_name: do not induce more distress than the science needs
spec_features.spec_quote: make the intent legible and stop the harness from inducing more distress than the science needs
spec_features.evidence: This umbrella claim is realized by cap_samples (welfare.py:68; enforced raise but only on scale>1, eval-only) and the resume cache (runner.py:78-79). The third pillar named for this purpose, DistressBudget, is dead code (never instantiated). So the harness genuinely avoids regenerating cached distress, but there is no active cap on *fresh* induction at default settings.
spec_features.notes: Some real enforcement (cache reuse, scale>1 guard) but not the full 'stop the harness' claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Don't induce more distress than the experiment needs.

spec_features.feature_name: hard global cap on total distressing generations
spec_features.spec_quote: A reasonable person could argue the guardrails should be stronger (e.g. a hard global cap on total distressing generations)
spec_features.evidence: No global counter of total distressing generations exists anywhere in code. cap_samples is per-category and only on scale>1; budgets default to 4000 resp/model (config.py SampleBudget). The text itself is DESIGN.md prose conceding the absence of such a cap.
spec_features.notes: Explicitly an acknowledged missing guardrail; not implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: suppressing expression without addressing internal states would be the worse outcome — for reliability and, if these states matter morally, for welfare
spec_features.evidence: Discussion prose in DESIGN.md only; no code mechanism.
